items.title: 未知设备命令注入可远程执行
items.title_zh: 未知设备命令注入可远程执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵 wlan_ssid 参数注入系统命令，可能导致设备被控制。
items.action_zh: 确认受影响产品并升级固件，限制管理接口公网暴露
items.repro_note: 入口与 wlan_ssid 参数相关，需确认产品及接口前置条件
items.impact_scope: 未知网络设备，可能暴露于边界
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WAVLINK WL-WN579A3-A 2026-03-10-94f93d4. The impacted element is the function set_wzdgwMesh of the file /cgi-bin/adm.cgi of the component Initial Setup Wizard. The manipulation of the argument wlan_ssid leads to os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: WAVLINK路由器命令注入可远程执行
items.title_zh: WAVLINK路由器命令注入可远程执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者操纵 group_name/IP-FROM 参数注入系统命令，可能导致设备被控制。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复固件；临时限制 /protocol.csp 访问
items.repro_note: 访问 /protocol.csp，操纵 group_name/IP-FROM，需对应型号
items.impact_scope: 消费级路由器，可能暴露于公网或内网边界
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in WAVLINK WL-WN530BE1-A V251117. Affected is the function con_check_read_finish of the file /protocol.csp. Such manipulation of the argument group_name/IP-FROM leads to command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过 port_forward 的 Name 参数注入系统命令，可能导致设备被控制。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；临时限制 /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi 访问
items.repro_note: 访问 /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi 的 port_forward，操纵 Name 参数
items.impact_scope: 消费级路由器，常作边界或内网接入
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in WAVLINK WN579X3-D V250402. This affects the function port_forward of the file /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi. The manipulation of the argument Name results in os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
